account.buyingPower.long:
Cash buying power per currency via the official Open API.

A different concept from the orderable amounts in `account summary`, which is why
it is its own command. This is the only route to buying power with an official
key and no web session.
account.commission.long: Reports the trading commission this account is charged, per market. For a single symbol's commission and tax, use `quote commission`.
account.commission.short: Show the account's commission schedule (KR equities, US equities, US options)
account.detail.long:
The read-only half of the web's 계좌관리 screen: what the account is (number, name, status, open date, last trade), what can be withdrawn today and as settlement completes (with per-transaction and daily caps), and whether 미수거래 (buying on receivable credit) is open per market.

The account number is masked by default because this output gets pasted into issues and chat — pass --full to show it. Sections that fail to load are reported as warnings rather than failing the command. Account-changing actions from that screen (closing the account, changing the PIN, moving money) are deliberately not exposed. WTS-only.
account.detail.short: Account identity, withdrawal limits, and credit-trading status
account.interest.long: Per-payment breakdown of the interest Toss pays on the KRW cash balance: payment date, pre-tax amount, tax, net amount, and the accrual period. For a single period total, use `profit summary --type account-interest`.
account.interest.short: Annual deposit-interest history (interest paid on the KRW cash balance)
account.prime.long: Shows Toss Prime membership status and this month's fee/interest benefit comparison (non-member vs Prime vs your actual applied rate). Works for non-members too.
account.prime.short: Show Prime membership status and fee/interest benefits
account.summary.short: Show a summary for the selected account
accumulate.list.long: Show every stock-accumulation (주식모으기) plan on the account — recurring automatic buys — including which are Active vs Paused, the amount/quantity and frequency, and how many rounds have completed. WTS-only.
accumulate.list.short: List every accumulation plan on the account (all stocks, all statuses)
accumulate.status.long: Show the stock-accumulation (주식모으기) plan(s) for a single stock, including whether it's Active or Paused. Accepts a ticker (e.g. 005930, AAPL) or a Toss product code. WTS-only.
accumulate.status.short: Show the accumulation plan(s) for one stock
auth.doctor.short: Check whether auth login prerequisites are ready
auth.extend.short: Extend session via Toss app push approval
auth.import-playwright-state.short: Import Playwright storage state into tossctl session storage
community.boards.long: Toss community lounges ordered by follower count. The server's order is preserved — that order is the ranking.
community.rankings.long:
Community leaderboards (influencers, returns, follower surges).

Note: uses a WTS internal endpoint; not available via the official Open API and may change without notice.
community.short: Toss community leaderboards and social data
config.init.short: Create a default config.json with trading disabled
config.show.short: Show the effective config and config path

doctor.long:
Check whether tossctl is ready on this machine.

Use --report to emit a JSON diagnostic bundle (endpoint-family probes, file
permissions, orphan cache files). Paths are redacted to '~' so the output
can be pasted into bug reports without leaking the local username.
doctor.short: Check whether tossctl is ready on this machine
export.short: Export read-only data to machine-friendly formats (CSV/JSON)
init.long:
Interactively set up authentication via an official Open API key or a web session.
In non-interactive (CI/AI) environments, prints flag-based command guidance and exits cleanly.
init.msg.applyLink: If you don't have an official Open API key yet, apply first: %s
init.msg.nonInteractiveGuidance:
In a non-interactive environment, set up auth with one of these commands:
  Web session:    tossctl auth login
  Official Open API:  tossctl openapi login --key <KEY> --secret <SECRET>
init.prompt.choiceBoth: Both (recommended) — stability + maximum coverage, with fallback if the official API is down
init.prompt.choiceOfficial: Official Open API key only — core supported features only. Most stable (auto token refresh, no browser needed)
init.prompt.choiceWeb: Web session login only — unlocks unofficial features too, but disconnects sooner and needs more frequent renewal
init.short: Interactive onboarding wizard for authentication setup
lending.expected.long: Show projected income from lending out your holdings (대주): monthly and yearly estimates in USD plus a per-stock breakdown. Works even for accounts without an active lending agreement (shows zeros). WTS-only.
lending.expected.short: Projected share-lending income (per stock, monthly/yearly USD)
market.anomalies.long:
Indices Toss badged as moving unusually, with the AI signal attached to each.
zscore is how far the move sits from that index's own recent distribution.
market.briefing.long:
Personalized AI news briefing.

Note: uses a WTS internal endpoint; not available via the official Open API and may change without notice.
market.businessDays.long:
Session times for the previous, current and next business day via the official
Open API. KR includes single-price auction windows; US includes the day market.

This is the only route to session times with an official key and no web session.
`market hours` shows the same kind of information through the web session.
market.businessDays.short: Trading calendar (previous, today, next session times)
market.calendar.long:
Show one month of scheduled market events by date: economic releases with the street's forecast, the actual print once published and the prior value; Korean and US earnings announcements with their stock code and call time; and market holidays.

Use `--month YYYY-MM` for another month (default: the current one). Toss's weekly AI summary describes the present week, so it is attached only when you are looking at the current month.

WTS-only.
market.earnings.long: Upcoming earnings-call calendar. Use --major to show only major companies.
market.filters.short: Screener filter value ranges and base date
market.fx.short: USD/KRW FX and dollar index quotes
market.halt.long:
Shows whether a circuit breaker or sidecar is firing on KOSPI/KOSDAQ.
All four switches are listed whether or not they are firing — a normal day must
look different from a failed fetch.
market.hours.short: Today's KR and US trading session windows
market.index.long: Major market indices. Pass a symbol to get index detail (OHLC, 52-week range).
market.index.short: Major market indices (KOSPI, KOSDAQ, Nasdaq, S&P 500, VIX)
market.indicator.long: Fetch current prices for market indicators via the official Toss Open API. Requires a connected official key. Pass one or more catalog symbols; defaults to KOSPI,KOSDAQ.
market.indicator.short: Market indicator current price (KOSPI/KOSDAQ, official API key required)
market.indicatorCandles.long: Fetch OHLCV candles for one market indicator via the official Toss Open API. Requires a connected official key. --interval 1m|1d, --count up to 200.
market.indicatorCandles.short: Market indicator candles (OHLCV, official API key required)
market.investorTrading.long: Fetch market-wide investor trading (individual/foreigner/institution/other) via the official Toss Open API. Requires a connected official key. --interval 1d|1w|1mo|1y, --count up to 100.
market.investorTrading.short: Market investor trading (KOSPI/KOSDAQ, official API key required)
market.investors.short: Net-buy ranking by investor type (foreign, institutional, retail)
market.issues.long:
Show the topics the market is talking about most, ranked, with each topic's rank movement (▲▼) and article count.

A different axis from `market news` (flat headlines) and `market briefing` (AI category grouping): here the ranking of topics is the payload.

Use `--full` to print the articles behind each topic. WTS-only.
market.issues.short: Ranked market issue board (topics by rank)
market.news.long:
Market news with each article's related stocks and how they are moving — the part a plain headline list does not give you.

Scopes (--type): all (default, widest), recommended, watchlist, holdings, latest, soaring. A raw server enum also works, so a scope Toss adds later needs no release.

The server caps results at 50 and offers no pagination or search. Summaries are omitted by default (50 of them is a wall) — pass --full to include them. WTS-only.
market.news.short: Market news feed (headlines with related-stock moves)
market.optionHours.long: US options market sessions for the previous, current, and next business day. Equity hours are `market hours`; the two can diverge around holidays.
market.optionHours.short: US options business days and session hours (previous, today, next)
market.rankings.long: Fetch the official Toss Open API stock ranking. Requires a connected official key (`tossctl openapi login`). --type selects the ranking metric; --market and --duration scope it.
market.rankings.short: Official stock ranking (trading value/price change leaders, official API key required)
market.screener.long:
Stock screeners. With no argument, lists available presets; pass a preset id to run it.

For custom conditions, pass a raw JSON array via --filter (Toss web's filter schema):
  tossctl market screener --filter '[{"id":"marketCap","conditions":[...]}]' --nation kr

The filter vocabulary lives in Toss's web bundle and is not published, so the
practical way to build one is to start from a preset and adjust it:
  tossctl market screener --output json | jq '.presets[] | select(.id=="14") | .filters'
Copy that array, change a threshold, and pass it back via --filter.
market.screener.short: Stock screeners (value, dividend, growth, and more)
market.sectors.long:
Industry (TICS) sector fluctuations. With no argument, shows top-level sectors; pass an id to drill into sub-industries.

Note: uses a WTS internal endpoint; not available via the official Open API and may change without notice.
market.stocks.short: All listed stocks for a market (universe)
market.themes.long:
Theme fluctuation ranking (today's top-moving themes).

Note: uses a WTS internal endpoint; not available via the official Open API and may change without notice.
monitor.api.long:
Run schema-invariant probes against the read-only Toss endpoints the
CLI depends on. Designed for cron / launchd.

Exits 0 when every probe passes, 1 if any probe fails. Compose alert
channels (Discord, Slack, ntfy, mail, …) in the cron line via "||".
See AGENTS.md for recipes.
monitor.api.short: Run schema-invariant probes; exit 1 on any failure
monitor.short: Periodic health checks against Toss read-only endpoints
openapi.login.short: Save Open API credentials (non-interactive; --key and --secret required)
openapi.logout.short: Remove saved Open API credentials and token cache
openapi.status.short: Show Open API diagnostic dashboard (credentials, key status, IPs, connection)
openapi.test.short: Test saved Open API credentials against the live API
order.autotrade.long:
Show the automated-trading rules armed on the account: STOP_LOSS, PROFIT_RATE, OCO, OTO.

Read-only. Arming and cancelling happen in the Toss app or web only — the same stance `account detail` takes toward the 계좌관리 screen's actions.

Status is the server's numeric code translated to its enum name (6 → EXPIRED); the raw code is kept as `status_code`. WTS-only.
order.autotrade.short: List automated trading rules (stop-loss, target profit)
order.conditional.cancel.previewLine: Preview: this will cancel the conditional order. Rerun with --execute --confirm <token>.
order.conditional.cancel.short: Cancel a conditional order (official API key required)
order.conditional.get.short: Show one conditional order (official API key required)
order.conditional.list.short: List conditional orders (official API key required)
order.conditional.long:
List and inspect conditional orders via the official Toss Open API. Requires a connected official key.

Trigger sessions differ by market: KR stocks only trigger during KRX regular hours, while overseas stocks trigger in every tradable session. A KR conditional order placed after the close is not watched until the next regular session.
order.conditional.modify.short: Modify a conditional order (official API key required)
order.conditional.place.long: Create a stop/trigger conditional order via the official Toss Open API. Requires a connected official key AND config opt-in. Run without --execute for a preview + confirm token.
order.conditional.place.short: Create a conditional order (official API key required)
order.funding.long: Reports whether buying is possible right now and, when it is blocked, how much must be deposited or exchanged first. For amounts already orderable, use `account summary` — this one reports the gap.
order.funding.short: Whether a buy can go through now, and the deposit or exchange still needed
order.long: Trading commands are intentionally separate from read-only commands and default to a local preview + explicit execute/confirm gates before any live mutation.
order.place.short: Place a live order with explicit danger approval
order.short: Preview, inspect, and manage trading actions
order.show.short: Show a single order from pending or current-month completed history
orders.completed.short: List completed-history orders for the current month

portfolio.dividends.long:
Annual dividend report (total, region, monthly).

Note: uses a WTS internal endpoint; not available via the official Open API and may change without notice.
profit.daily.long: List realized profit per stock per date — symbol, quantity, profit/loss, rate, and the sell/buy amounts behind it. Every page is fetched and combined. The API scopes each call to one currency, so by default both KRW and USD are queried and the rows merged; narrow with --currency. Omit --from/--to for the whole history. Useful for tax prep and for answering "what did this position actually make?". WTS-only.
profit.daily.short: Per-stock realized profit, day by day
profit.long: Show the account's cumulative realized profit across every category — trading gains, dividends, share-lending, maturity, and deposit interest — each in KRW and USD. This is a cumulative view distinct from `account summary` (current holdings valuation). WTS-only.
profit.summary.long: Show realized profit for a single category (sales, dividend, lending, account-interest) — earned amount, rate, and purchase basis in KRW and USD. Omit --from/--to for the whole history; give both for a date range. This is the period-scoped counterpart to `tossctl profit`, which is all-time and covers every category at once. WTS-only.
profit.summary.short: Realized profit for one category over a date range
push.listen.short: Stream SSE events as JSON lines to stdout
push.short: Subscribe to Toss Securities push notifications (SSE)
quote.batch.short: Fetch quotes for multiple symbols at once (comma-separated supported)
quote.chart.short: Fetch candle chart for a symbol or stock name
quote.charts.long:
Today's intraday candles for several symbols in a single request.
Range and step are chosen by the server (observed: 1d / 10m) — they are not
request parameters. To pick an interval use `quote chart <symbol> --interval`.

Symbols the server has no data for are omitted without an error and reported
separately.
quote.charts.short: Intraday candles for many symbols in one call
quote.flows.short: Investor-type net flows (KR: retail, foreign, institutional)
quote.get.short: Fetch quote data for a symbol or stock name
quote.limits.short: Fetch daily upper and lower price band
quote.reasoning.short: Why a stock moved (Toss AI explanation)
quote.reasons.long:
One line per stock on why it is moving, up to 100 symbols in a single request.
For the full card on one symbol (summary, direction, related stocks) use
`quote reasoning <symbol>`.

Stocks with no reasoning are omitted, so you may get back fewer than you asked for.
quote.reasons.short: Why many stocks are moving, in one call (AI)
quote.sellable.short: Sellable quantity for a held symbol
quote.supply.short: Stock supply (investor / short / credit / lending / program)
quote.trades.short: Fetch recent executed ticks for a symbol
root.long: tossctl is the CLI binary for tossinvest-cli, an unofficial Toss Securities web client with browser-assisted login and a narrow trading beta surface.
root.short: CLI for Toss Securities web data and trading experiments
stream.long:
Subscribe to the official Open API websocket and print live execution, order book and own-order events as JSON lines.

All channels share one connection (the protocol is a declarative full-replace subscription).
No snapshot is sent on subscribe — only updates from that point on, so read current state with `quote`/`orders` first.
6-digit numeric symbols are treated as KRX, everything else as US.

Examples:
  tossctl stream --trade AAPL,005930
  tossctl stream --orderbook 005930 --order
stream.short: Stream live executions, order book and order events (websocket)
tax.overseas.long: Show the overseas-stock transfer-income (양도소득) report for a tax year: tax summary (rate, deduction, tax due) plus every sold stock's profit/loss line. For capital-gains tax filing. Amounts in KRW. Use --year to pick the tax year. WTS-only.
tax.overseas.short: Overseas-stock transfer income (capital gains) for a tax year
tax.ria.long: Estimated overseas capital-gains tax with the RIA deduction applied, and the resulting saving. For plain filing figures, use `tax overseas`. This surface exists only in the Toss mobile app.
tax.ria.short: RIA account tax-saving report (overseas capital-gains saving account)
transactions.list.short: List transactions (trades + cash flow) for a market
transactions.long: Read-only access to Toss Securities' transaction ledger. Covers trades, deposits/withdrawals, dividends, and stock in/out per market. Toss caps a single query at 200 days and paginates.
transactions.overview.short: Show cash overview for a market (orderable, withdrawable, upcoming deposits)
transactions.short: Read transaction ledger (trades, cash flow, stock in/out)
update.long: Detects how this tossctl binary was installed (Homebrew, install.sh/install.ps1, or a source build) and upgrades it using that same mechanism.
update.short: Update tossctl to the latest version
watchlist.add.short: Add a symbol to the watchlist
watchlist.list.short: List watchlist entries (one folder, or all)
watchlist.remove.short: Remove a symbol from the watchlist
